title: NHRC and SHRCs
quote: "Toothless tiger": non-binding advice, one-year bar, armed-forces limit

boxes.title: Status & establishment
items: ==**Statutory**, not constitutional==: **PHRA 1993**, per **Paris Principles**
Ordinance **28 Sept 1993**; constituted ==**12 October 1993**==; assent **Jan 1994**
First Chairperson: **Justice Ranganath Misra**; present: **Justice V. Ramasubramanian**
SHRC is **optional**: State "may" constitute
Secretary-General: administrative & financial powers, not judicial

boxes.title: Composition: NHRC vs SHRC
head: NHRC
SHRC
rows: SC judge; HC CJ/judge; **3** experts (1 woman)

levels.name: Speaker of Lok Sabha; Union Home Minister
LoP Lok Sabha; LoP Rajya Sabha

boxes.title: Amendments 2006 & 2019
head: Year
Change
rows: Visit jails ==without intimating State Govt==; interim relief during inquiry
SHRC **five → three**; transfer complaints to SHRC
Chair: CJI **or** SC judge; deemed members **4 → 7**; UT functions to SHRC

boxes.title: Powers & functions
items: Civil court powers (**CPC 1908**): summon, documents, public records, affidavits
Inquiry **suo motu**, on petition or court direction - violations by **public servants**
Recommend **compensation, prosecution, interim relief**; govt reports action in ==**one month**==
**Bonded labour** monitoring entrusted by SC (**1997**); custodial death report in **24 hours**
Encounter deaths: **PUCL v Maharashtra (2014)**
⚠ Cannot **punish** violators

boxes.title: Limitations
items: No inquiry ==**after one year**== of the act
**Armed forces**: only seek Central report; action in **three months**
Advisory, **not binding**; sub judice matters not taken
No overlap with SHRC / other commission; **Delhi** handled by NHRC
Allahabad HC: exceeded mandate (**558** madrasas, 2026); SHRCs **80 paisa** per capita

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: APPSC-GS 2023: "constitutional body", "established 1994" = ==both false==
APPSC-G2 2025: constituted **1993**; APPSC 2025: appointed by **President**
MPPSC: "not eligible for re-appointment" = **wrong** statement
⚠ one month (general) vs **three months** (armed forces); time bar one year
Both NHRC & SHRC chairs ==removed by the President==
